title: Jude and the Will
author: Xanthe Dunmore
blurb: Xanthe Ravensworth, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
